name: MegaSuite
description: One menu for everything: QoL hacks, bugfixes and DVD Mode in a single MegaHack-style window. Press TAB to open.

speedhack-speed.name: Speedhack Speed
speedhack-speed.description: Gameplay speed multiplier used by the speedhack.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Toggles the game's debug hitbox drawing.

instant-respawn.name: Instant Respawn
instant-respawn.description: Skip the death delay and respawn immediately.

practice-music-sync.name: Practice Music Sync
practice-music-sync.description: Keep the song synced in practice mode.

startpos-switcher.name: StartPos Switcher
startpos-switcher.description: Use the left and right arrow keys to cycle start positions.

fix-practice-music-pulse.name: Fix Practice Music Pulse
fix-practice-music-pulse.description: Fixes the audio pulse effect breaking while practice music sync is on.

fix-dual-wave-trail.name: Fix Dual Wave Trail
fix-dual-wave-trail.description: Fixes the player 2 wave trail disappearing when leaving dual mode.

fix-dash-particles.name: Fix Dash Particles
fix-dash-particles.description: Restores the pre-2.2 ship and UFO click particle position.

fix-trigger-wave-particles.name: Fix Trigger Wave Particles
fix-trigger-wave-particles.description: Fixes wave particles spawned by a show/hide trigger being cleared.

fix-startpos-mirror.name: Fix StartPos Mirror
fix-startpos-mirror.description: Applies the start position's mirror mode setting on respawn.

fix-mini-swing.name: Fix Mini Swing
fix-mini-swing.description: Fixes the swing copter frame being wrong while mini.

dvd-enable.name: DVD Mode
dvd-enable.description: Makes every popup bounce around the screen forever.

dvd-speed.name: DVD Bounce Speed
dvd-speed.description: How fast popups bounce around the screen.

dvd-no-triggers.name: DVD Skip Trigger Popups
dvd-no-triggers.description: Keep editor trigger and color popups still.

dvd-heavy.name: DVD Heavy Popups
dvd-heavy.description: Heavier popups bounce slower, like the original mod.

ui-opacity.name: Menu Opacity
ui-opacity.description: Opacity of the MegaSuite window background.
